name: coinbase-candles
notes: Structural gates over one `candles` pull of source coinbase-btcusd-1m or coinbase-ethusd-1m (Coinbase Exchange 1-minute candles through restwindow). One suite for both products: no rule bounds a price LEVEL, because BTC and ETH differ by an order of magnitude. in_range cannot say strictly positive, so a price of exactly 0 passes; the gap check (a window the vendor answered short) is not in the rule vocabulary either: count rows per day with scan_stream (runbook section 8). Run: python -m dskit.onboarding validate --suite configs/suite-coinbase-candles.json --snapshot <snapshot-vid> --root <store root>.

rules.notes: An empty pull is a broken pull (wrong product, a start in the future, an API change).
One row per minute: the connector clips each window to [lo, hi) so a bound both windows return is stored once; a duplicate means that failed.

Epoch SECONDS from 2024-01-01 (the shipped start) to 2100. A backstop: the connector already refuses a millisecond value and drops a row outside its window, so this trips only on a row the pack let through.
The effective instant the connector writes beside the raw time.
The span stops a minute before now (lag 60), so a candle dated after acquisition is a defect.
